# DUOTEK Information Technologies LLC (Duotek Group)

> Dubai technology company delivering IT support, ELV infrastructure, business communications, security, automation, and custom software across the UAE.

## About

Duotek Group was established in Dubai in 2015. The company helps businesses and property owners plan, install, support, and improve workplace technology and connected systems. Its core practice covers IT and ELV infrastructure, supported by a dedicated custom software and digital engineering capability.

## Primary Pages

- [Home](https://duotek.ae/): Overview of Duotek's IT, ELV, automation, security, communications, and software capabilities.
- [IT & ELV Services](https://duotek.ae/services): Detailed service scopes and project enquiry options across 11 IT & ELV infrastructure areas.
- [Software](https://duotek.ae/software): Bespoke web applications, iOS/Android mobile apps, client portals, APIs, and business automation in Dubai.

- [Terms & Conditions](https://duotek.ae/terms): Official legal and commercial terms of engagement.

## IT and ELV Services

- IT AMC and ongoing user support.
- Cat6/Cat6A structured cabling and fiber infrastructure.
- Network rack installation, cleanup, labeling, and power organization.
- Business networking, managed switches, Wi-Fi, firewalls, and VPNs.
- Physical and virtual server installation and configuration.
- IP telephony, business phone systems, and 3CX IP PBX.
- CCTV surveillance and remote viewing.
- Biometric, card, and facial-recognition access control.
- Smart home and commercial automation.
- Business email configuration and migration planning.

## Custom Software Services

- Custom web applications and client portals.
- Business dashboards and workflow tools.
- iOS and Android mobile applications.
- Cloud backends and secure APIs.
- ERP and CRM integrations.
- Workflow automation and compatible IoT or ELV system integration.

Software engagements begin with requirements discovery and are scoped around the users, workflows, data, integrations, security needs, and deployment plan of each project.

## Industries and Project Types

Duotek works with requirements across corporate offices, commercial fit-outs, logistics, healthcare facilities, retail, hospitality, education, sports facilities, warehouses, SMEs, and residential properties. Services are subject to project assessment, site conditions, and an agreed scope.
